test_elementwise_layer: test the pz.nn.Elementwise layer with a JAX activation function like jax.nn.relu
test_softmax_layer: test the pz.nn.Softmax layer applied along specified named axes like ('foo', 'bar')
test_check_layer_tracing: test the check_layers_by_tracing.check_layer utility to validate layer configuration via jax.eval_shape
create_elementwise_layer: create a pz.nn.Elementwise layer wrapping an elementwise function such as jax.nn.relu
create_softmax_layer: create a pz.nn.Softmax layer that applies softmax along a given set of named axes
